audio.mono_conversion: arithmetic mean of channels in float64 before resampling
audio.zero_crossing_rule: minimize abs(linear crossing amplitude), then distance from target end, then earliest index; select an exact-length window ending there
audio.gain_rule: minimum of loudness-target gain and peak-ceiling gain
audio.dither: deterministic TPDF at one PCM16 LSB using numpy PCG64 seed 0
audio.short_input: reject; regenerate only with documented model speed controls, or increment protocol version for any transcript change

measurement_definitions.generation_wall_seconds: CLOCK_MONOTONIC elapsed around the documented model generation API only; excludes environment setup and downloads
measurement_definitions.api_first_output_seconds: CLOCK_MONOTONIC from the same API invocation start until its first returned or yielded audio payload, including silence
measurement_definitions.first_audible_output_seconds: from API start to the first 10 ms analysis frame at or above -50 dBFS RMS; null when unavailable
measurement_definitions.peak_rss_bytes: maximum process-tree resident set sampled from Linux /proc at 100 ms or faster, including the parent and all descendants; report baseline separately
measurement_definitions.audio_hash: SHA-256 of the exact file bytes
measurement_definitions.rms_dbfs: 20*log10(sqrt(mean(float_sample^2))) with PCM full scale 1.0; negative infinity for digital silence
measurement_definitions.peak_dbfs: 20*log10(max(abs(float_sample))) with PCM full scale 1.0; negative infinity for digital silence
measurement_definitions.integrated_loudness: ITU-R BS.1770 K-weighted gated mono loudness, reported in LUFS

raw_preservation.write_mode: exclusive; never modify or replace a captured native file

revision_rule: An accepted preview is valid only when protocol_version, transcript_sha256, and protocol_fingerprint match this manifest. Any transcript byte, including punctuation, requires a new version and invalidates every prior acceptance.
